name: Glass post reactions
oneLiner: a social post on glass (real face, name, the line, a brand screenshot) drifts in slow 3D; a finger holds Like, a tray of five reaction coins pops out of the button, the heart swells under the finger and drops into the button, then a burst of reaction coins springs off the bar and floats up while the count rolls like an odometer
say: when the speaker says people loved a post or it blew up ('people went crazy for this one', 'the reactions kept coming'): cut in on the post, the heart drops in and the reactions burst as they say how many. Set countFrom and count to the real before and after
